profile.headline: Software Development Engineer
profile.summary: A highly skilled full stack developer who performs well in a team and cross-functionally across an organization, with a commitment to creating quality, well tested software.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed and maintained several core on-prem product. Functioned as the primary point of contact for customer escalations, investigating and implementing fixes for product defects with minimal turn around time.

positions.title: QA Automation Engineer
positions.description: Led an initiative to expand automated testing in company development processes, finding issues sooner in the development pipeline and improving product quality. Developed tests for web front ends using a variety of frameworks, along with scripts to replace laborious and error prone manual tests of desktop applications.

positions.title: Global Buisness NAS Trainer
positions.description: Provided in-depth training on existing and upcoming business oriented networking devices to the entire corporation, from technical support staff to product managers. Managed Corporate 8D methodology to analyze product issues and identify short term fixes and long term process changes to improve product quality.

certifications.name: OWASP Top 10: #1 Injection and #2 Broken Authentication
